evidence: Scope: the five assembled dimension prompts = prompt.md + app_context.md + injected criteria. (2) Credentials: app_context.md:7-18 lists the same ten accounts, roles and password Hireops!2026 as instruction.md:19, hireops_rules.md section 1 and seed users (USR-REC1..3, USR-MGR1..3, USR-OBS1, USR-CAN1..3). (3) Seeded entities quoted in prompts/criteria all re-derived from seed_data.json: three jobs (Platform Engineer/Infrastructure, Data Analyst/Finance Systems, Product Designer/Design); Data Analyst exists for the gate (constraints judge.toml:25, functional/polish/visual prompt gate); Yuki Tanaka is MGR3 = Product Designer manager (functional prompt.md:21); Noor's Platform Engineer conversation has 120 messages (app_context.md:31); hro_intake_restart quotes Applied Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi (positions 1-3) and Screen Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz, and Noor's note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (APP-101 note) - all exact; hro_unread_seen 'Lena's count is 1' = 3 messages in APP-301, Lena read_count 2, third is by USR-REC3; hro_candidate statuses Noor Platform Engineer (Infrastructure, Interviewing), Product Designer (Design, Application received), Tomas Data Analyst (Finance Systems, In review) match stages INTERVIEW/APPLIED/SCREEN and candidate_status_labels; page size 30 matches thread_page_size; 404/403/401 expectations match hireops_rules.md section 1. (4) Cross-references between prompts and criteria resolve: hro_intake_restart, hro_unread_seen, hro_two_people, hro_long_thread, hro_messaging, hro_moves, hro_reject_reopen, hro_candidate, hro_pol_session_resume all exist; functional prompt.md:11 ('graded in separate sessions') matches functional judge.toml mode = "individual". (5) Residue: grep over tests/ and task.toml for colderwater|editor|caret|notebook|ticket|invoice|warehouse|kanban|tenant|TODO|TBD|lorem|CHANGE_ME|{{|placeholder|example.com returned nothing; the template's 'persistence criterion is last' restart section and CHANGE_ME placeholders are absent; the only URLs in prompts are http://localhost:3000 (Colderwater lesson 13: no public addresses). (b) functional prompt.md:1 repeats 'No shell.' after 'No shell or private-file probes.' - harmless duplication, not residue.
